question: In a certain code language, 'FOAMING' is written as 'AOFMGNI'. How will 'BELIEVE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'FOAMING' is written as 'AOFMGNI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdf5bbe3a4cec882d5d3b464bc052386297d8fd1fd360f03268dfd794fd62713.png] 

Similarly,

'BELIEVE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d04dab352b10231680858db0427d28d17690f5ed5005f7e7243fff9243fe36f6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"LEBIEVE".**
